### Full Job Description
Summary:
Software Engineer II building React and Node.js applications for Metronet’s fiber-optic technology and operations teams. Developing APIs, geospatial tools, and mapping functionality.
Software Engineer II building full-stack web applications for Metronet’s fiber-optic operations
Role description:
• Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain full-stack web applications using React, Node.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript
• Enhance and extend existing applications with new functionality as business needs evolve
• Develop front-end experiences and back-end services for internal business and operational applications
• Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrations
• Build responsive, intuitive, and maintainable React user interfaces
• Develop custom mapping and geospatial functionality within web applications
• Work with business stakeholders, product owners, engineers, and operations teams to understand requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions
• Troubleshoot and resolve application, API, integration, and database issues across development and production environments
• Participate in technical design, code reviews, testing, documentation, and continuous improvement
• Identify opportunities to improve application performance, usability, automation, and operational efficiency
• Contribute to software projects from requirements through delivery and ongoing support
• Perform other job-related duties as requested
Role requirements:
• Professional experience developing software using React, Node.js, and TypeScript
• Strong working knowledge of JavaScript
• Professional experience building and supporting web applications
• Professional experience developing across the full application stack, including front-end and back-end development
• Experience developing and consuming APIs/integrations
• Ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions
• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
• Effective written and verbal communication skills
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a development team
• Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship
• Experience with Esri/ArcGIS technologies preferred
• Experience developing mapping or geospatial web applications preferred
• Experience with the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript or ArcGIS APIs preferred
• Experience using Three.js or similar JavaScript visualization technologies preferred
• Experience working with geospatial data or GIS workflows preferred
• Experience integrating mapping applications with REST APIs and enterprise data sources preferred
• Experience with Git, CI/CD, and automated testing preferred
Benefits:
• 80% of medical premiums paid by the company
• Company-paid disability and life insurance
• 401(k)-company match
• Discounted services within coverage areas
• Competitive total compensation package
• Locally owned, friendly, and fun atmosphere
• Growth and success opportunities
• Recognized as one of the Best Places to Work
Tech stack:
JavaScript, Node.js, React, TypeScript
Company sponsorship flag: sponsorsH1B=true.
